author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: अत्र विश्वरूपस्य परमित्युत्तमत्वोक्तिः अज्ञजनापेक्षयैव । ब्रह्मादीनां कृष्णाद्यवतारेष्वपि परत्वधीसत्त्वादिति
translation: The Blessed Lord said: By Me, graciously has been shown to thee, by My own will and power, this supreme form, O Arjuna; it is the embodiment of radiance, perfect, unlimited by time and space, the first of all, which form of Mine by any other than thyself was not seen before. (47.)
